question: Can a causal gain or activity/region-balanced voltage objective preserve the 06b-h regenerative rescue while repairing quiescent, moderate and somatic voltage transitions?

arms.raw_bridge_control: train the bridge with the original active-weighted voltage loss
arms.activity_balanced_bridge: train the bridge with inverse-frequency activity-bin weights
arms.activity_region_balanced_bridge: train the bridge with inverse-frequency activity-by-region weights
arms.global_gain_balanced: freeze the bridge and train one bounded global gain with the activity-balanced loss
arms.causal_gain_balanced: freeze the bridge and train a sub-1000-parameter bounded gain from raw predicted delta, current voltage and region

roles.reason_for_reuse: all eight independent train components have already been consumed; the experiment measures component learnability only

decision_rule.primary_passes: authorize only a fresh-train-support causal-gain confirmation
decision_rule.primary_fails_fallback_passes: authorize only a fresh-train-support activity-region confirmation
decision_rule.diagnostic_arm_only_passes: register a new hypothesis; do not select it retrospectively
decision_rule.no_arm_passes: return to an atomic voltage-bridge representation revision
